nodes.label: Reconnaissance
nodes.details: The adversary quietly scrapes OSINT sources, cataloging services, exposed ports, and leaked credentials before making a move.
checkpoints: Harvest employee emails and open services
Enumerate VPN and remote access portals
detection: Track anomalous scanning volume against VPN gateways
Correlate credential stuffing attempts across providers

nodes.label: Initial Access
nodes.details: A spear-phishing lure convinces an analyst to execute a malicious payload that beacons back to command and control.
checkpoints: Establish outbound connection to staging server
detection: Inspect email gateway logs for unusual attachment types
Monitor EDR for script interpreter spawns from mail clients
mitigation: Train staff with contextual phishing simulations

nodes.label: Privilege Escalation
nodes.details: Living-off-the-land binaries abuse local token privileges to inherit domain administrator capabilities.
checkpoints: Dump cached credentials from compromised endpoint
Leverage token manipulation to hop onto domain controller
detection: Alert on unusual use of PowerShell with encoded commands
Audit privileged group membership changes in real-time
mitigation: Harden PowerShell logging and enforce constrained language mode

nodes.label: Lateral Movement
nodes.details: Attacker pivots using remote service protocols, copying tooling across file shares to broaden foothold.
checkpoints: Scan internal network segments for additional assets
Reuse harvested credentials to authenticate laterally
detection: Alert on abnormal SMB session creation volumes
Watch for RDP logons outside approved maintenance windows
mitigation: Segment networks to limit pivot paths
Deploy honey accounts to detect credential reuse

nodes.label: Impact
nodes.details: Critical file shares are encrypted and exfiltrated, culminating in a double-extortion ultimatum.
detection: Detect mass file renames with ransomware signatures
Monitor outbound data spikes to untrusted destinations
mitigation: Maintain immutable backups and tested recovery plans
Implement DLP policies on sensitive repositories
